text:
maya: Quick report  cloned the minimal Next samplekit (LangChain + embeddings) and ran into two small DX issues: embeddings not showing up in telemetry and occasional 401s after token rotate. Anyone else?
jon: I can repro. Steps: yarn, NEXT dev, set RW_KEY, run /api/embeds -> no embed events in the dev console. If I call /api/rotate-token then immediately call /api/embeds, first requests 401 then succeed after a retry.
rachel: Starter creates embedding client at module import with `new RedwoodEmbeddings(process.env.RW_KEY)`. That caches the token. We should factory the client per-request or switch the SDK adapter to read a tokenProvider.
paul: For telemetry, the embed path in the sample does `await embedClient.embed(text)` but never calls the starter's telemetry wrapper. The Python sample emits events. Looks parity-ish.
maya: Filed DE-537 for this: "minimal-samplekit: embeds missing telemetry & stale token after rotation". Assigning to @jon and @rachel.
ci-bot: created issue DE-537 and applied label needs-e2e.
jon: I'll open a tiny PR for the sample: create client per-request and call `telemetry.emit('embedding.generated', { model })` after each embed. Add a unit that asserts telemetry called.
rachel: I'll tackle the token path in the SDK adapter: add optional `tokenProvider` callback so instances read current token on each request. Add an integration that posts rotate-token then runs a few embed calls asserting no 401.
paul: Temporary workaround for devs: recreate client inside the Next API handler: ```js
export default async function handler(req,res){
  const embeds = new RedwoodEmbeddings({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })
  await telemetry.wrap(async ()=> embeds.embed(req.body.text))
}
```
maya: Good. Once PRs are green, cherry-pick into the quickstart generator and update the samplekit README with the workaround and note about RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN env var for opt-in session telemetry.
jon: PR #141 opened with sample changes and unit. Will link CI when green.
rachel: Adding GH action e2e job that runs the harness on node 18/20 and simulates token rotate to catch regressions.
paul: Thanks all. Small fixes but big DX improvement for onboarding.
